If the behavior keeps recurring, set a simple, agreed consequence—such as doing an extra chore or covering a cleaning service fee—and write the plan down so expectations are clear.  
If repeated attempts don't work, request a short mediated talk with a neutral friend, another housemate, or your landlord to reset expectations.
